qa_pg_desc: Questions nobody asked, and answers nobody needed.
qa_1_1_q: When did you start posting content?
qa_1_1_a: Toward the end of 2025, I started posting my content on one of the popular social media platforms that features vertical-format videos.
qa_2_1_q: Where did your username came from?
qa_2_1_a:
From a lack of creativity - the location during the period when I began my public activity was cold, and due to my innate tendency to fall into various kinds of illness, a head covering didn't seem like a stupid idea.

It was THE idea itself that was stupid - providing really very little protection against low temperatures. It was the Kaptur (pol. Kaptur), and knowing the content I decided to focus on at the time, the name KapturNaSłuch (lit. HoodOnHearing) wasn't hard to come up with.

I used to also use the nickname captur - for lack of a better idea, and hoodB, to which I really want to associate myself with and to which I’d stick on like a leech if I knew how to pronounce it appropriately in my native language.
qa_3_1_q: Why do you make videos about these particular subjects?
qa_3_1_a:
Sound accompanied me through half of my youth and will stay with me until the end of my life.

Throughout my entire existence I have produced relatively few pieces, and today I can be described as a person in a state of rest.

After some time I decided that the only thing left for me, in a surge of uneducated, unsublimated, and unsubjected-to-the-standards-of-grandmaster-art drivel, would be to join their ranks, and then gradually inject my knowledge into them through precisely this kind of content.

Science and literature from unknown authors have stopped ruling human clarity of mind long time ago, and have no chance of reaching absolutely anyone.
qa_3_2_q: Why is it so hard to understand you?
qa_3_2_a:
A very long time ago I was involved in a certain accident. That accident was learning my native language. Its consequence was completing all grades of primary school, and then acquiring the skill of so-called "waffling", which in the eyes of simple people causes disgust, and among the younger, confusion. Sometimes both, sometimes reversed, sometimes combined.

I dare say, however, that my vocabulary is at the highest world level, which cannot be compared to the number of works of fine literature whose content I have ever familiarized myself with. These can be counted on the fingers of two hands.

The last school reading I have read from cover to cover without the slightest grimace of discouragement was titled "The Boys of Paul Street". I was at most 13 years old at the time.

However, with the moment I completed my education, I began to appreciate my native language more, and to avoid ALL borrowings and(!) neologisms far and wide, though I am not so fiercely stubborn in my bad writing to force myself to use archaisms.

I think that this is precisely the reason why my content is difficult to absorb - I can use the language of a wise person, whereas the dialect of the modern consumer is a foreign concept to me.

If, however, my statements were read aloud, they would be registered by all listeners, but interpreted and absorbed by consecutively smaller groups of people.

Someone should diagnose me.
qa_3_3_q: How do you deal with unfair criticism?
qa_3_3_a:
Envy toward me is my daily bread. I am a person banned on at least five audiophile forums. So, as one can guess, expressing my own views comes too easily to me.

The target audience environment of my content despises intelligent people. Its members consist of people who gained their experience through practice, for which they had to prepare by tediously studying theory.
One of their problems - aside from ego and narcissism preceding logic by light years - is the lack of desire for further knowledge acquirement. I think that no one in their right mind appends the highest academic titles before their name in order to expand their experience further. Even if those titles are made up.

My difference in views combined with the ability for coherent reasoning and flowery vocabulary are precisely what the people who describe themselves with the aforementioned, elite prefixes, fear the most.

There exists a certain very interesting boundary in human reasoning, after crossing which the ability to think logically turns into fear. This can be compared to debates between individuals with extreme good and bad views - the former have - for lack of better words - "flushed" a certain fragment of memory in the mind, which in the latter is occupied by a non-zero amount of data constituting the majority of the opponent's head content.

Radicals, however, have at least one basic defense mechanism, the use of which depends on the amount of logical arguments they encounter. The length of the fuse used to ignite it is regulated by the opponent.

This mechanism is called fury.
qa_3_4_q: To what extent do statistics influence what topics you choose for subsequent publications?
qa_3_4_a:
Numbers in the public space are merely values in databases and cannot be a component that determines both the quality of life and the priority of work that needs to be done.

Or at least I imagine that people with a three-digit IQ think that way. As it happens, mine consists of exactly that many digits.
qa_3_5_q: What does your work on the video look like?
qa_3_5_a:
1. First I have to find an idea, and then write a draft of the script.
  2. After that I give it to several popular artificial intelligence models to check.
  3. After applying sometimes hundreds of manual corrections, I try to find a free time to go in front of the camera.
  4. Once I have it, I need to dress up.
  5. Then connect the appropriate equipment and start recording.
  6. Afterward comes the matter of transferring the material to the computer...
  7. ...and editing it.
    This process can take even several dozen days.
  8. In the meantime, I handle audio processing
    This is the only fully automated process.
  9. After processing the sound files, it's time to export the video...
  10. ...and in the meantime, create the thumbnail.
    It's a trifle and therefore the most pleasant moment in the creative process, which takes me no more than an hour to complete.
  11. After transferring the finished data to a mobile device, the final steps are:
  12. adjusting the subtitles style, their lengths, create description... and publication date.
qa_3_6_q: Where do you draw inspiration from?
qa_3_6_a:
From everything that surrounds me and that I can connect to the topics I speak about. And moreover...

"A person sometimes believes he's seen all the way to the bottom of the well of human stupidity, and a reminder that that well apparently has no bottom is sometimes useful."Stephen King

This quote is particularly close to me because it reminds me that there will ALWAYS be someone who, in a TRULY extreme situation, I can criticize.

In my work I try to be confrontational with everything I possibly can, but there is a certain group that I treat with an enormous - for my temperament - dose of tolerance.

That group is called people.
qa_3_7_q: Do you have any material "in the drawer" that you put a lot of work into but ultimately never published?
qa_3_7_a:
Unpublished content is an inseparable consequence of self-criticism and development, at least in art.

Projects whose publication has been halted remain in that state mainly due to an insufficiently thought-out script, which - upon further reflection - can be written much better.
qa_3_8_q: In what direction would you like to develop your activity in two or three years?
qa_3_8_a:
I wouldn't.

I view radically new things either as a threat or as something that requires thorough preparation, and I already devote a tremendous amount of time to create content.
Furthermore, I don't like surprises.
qa_3_9_q: If you could go back in time and give yourself one piece of advice before adding your first post, what would it be?
qa_3_9_a: Invest in a camera, good lighting, and adapters. Lots of adapters.
qa_3_10_q: What is the average payment you receive for a single post?
qa_3_10_a:
None.

The platforms where I'm active either don't give me that possibility or I don't meet their criteria in that regard.
